questions.question: The sides of a triangle are 37 cm, 44 cm and 15 cm. What is the length of its altitude corresponding to the side with the length of 44 cm?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Semi-perimeter (s) = (37 + 44 + 15) ÷ 2 = 48 cm.

Area using Heron's formula = √[48 × 11 × 4 × 33] = 264 cm².

Altitude on the 44 cm side = (2 × Area) ÷ Base = (2 × 264) ÷ 44 = 12 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The sides of the triangle are a = 37 cm, b = 44 cm, and c = 15 cm.

**Formula Used:**

Semi-perimeter, s = (a + b + c) ÷ 2

Area of triangle = √[s × (s − a) × (s − b) × (s − c)]

Area = 1/2 × base × height

 
 
 
 
 
 
 44 cm 15 cm 37 cm h = ? A B C D 

**Calculations:**

⇒ s = (37 + 44 + 15) ÷ 2 = 96 ÷ 2 = 48 cm.

⇒ Area = √[48 × (48 − 37) × (48 − 44) × (48 − 15)]

⇒ Area = √[48 × 11 × 4 × 33]

⇒ Area = √[(16 × 3) × 11 × 4 × (3 × 11)]

⇒ Area = √[64 × 9 × 121]

⇒ Area = 8 × 3 × 11 = 264 cm².

Now, substitute the calculated area and the given base (44 cm) into the altitude formula:

⇒ 264 = 1/2 × 44 × h

⇒ 264 = 22 × h

⇒ h = 264 ÷ 22

⇒ h = 12 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Heron's Formula

It is universally used to calculate the area of any triangle when the lengths of all three sides are known, without needing any altitude or angle. The formula is Area = √[s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)].

Altitudes of a Triangle

An altitude is a perpendicular line segment drawn from a vertex to the opposite side (or its extension). Every triangle has exactly three altitudes, which intersect at a single distinct point called the orthocenter.

Relation between Area and Altitude

Once the area is known, the altitude corresponding to any given base can be easily found using the standard formula: Area = 1/2 × base × height. It is notable that the shortest altitude of a triangle always corresponds to its longest side.

questions.question: A, B and C can complete a piece of work in 3, 4 and 6 days, respectively. How long (in days) will they take to complete thrice the same work, working together?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM(3, 4, 6) = 12 units.

Combined efficiency = (12 ÷ 3) + (12 ÷ 4) + (12 ÷ 6) = 4 + 3 + 2 = 9 units/day.

Thrice the work = 3 × 12 = 36 units.

Time taken = 36 ÷ 9 = 4 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A = 3 days

Time taken by B = 4 days

Time taken by C = 6 days

**Concept Used:**

Total Work = LCM of given days

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time Taken

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 A
 3
 12
 4
 
 

 B
 4
 3
 
 

 C
 6
 2
 
 

⇒ Combined efficiency of A, B, and C = 4 + 3 + 2 = 9 units/day

⇒ Target work to be completed = 3 × Original Total Work = 3 × 12 = 36 units

⇒ Time required for target work = Target Work ÷ Combined Efficiency

⇒ Time required = 36 ÷ 9 = 4 days

**∴ The correct answer is 4 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work and Wages

Wages are always distributed in proportion to the total work done by each individual. If they work for the exact same number of days, wages are directly divided in the ratio of their efficiencies.

Pipes and Cisterns

Filling pipes have positive efficiency, whereas emptying pipes (leaks) have negative efficiency. The net efficiency is their algebraic sum when working together.

Alternate Days Work

When individuals work on alternate days, the total work is calculated in cycles (e.g., a 2-day cycle for 2 people). Calculate the work done in one cycle, multiply to get close to the total work, and handle the remaining fractional work manually.

questions.question: From a point 40 m away from the foot of a tower, the angle of elevation of the top of the tower is 45°. Find the height of the tower.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a right-angled triangle, if the angle of elevation is 45°, the perpendicular height is exactly equal to the base distance.

This is because tan(45°) = 1, making it an isosceles right triangle.

Height of tower = Distance from foot = 40 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 40 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 
 45° A (Top) B (Foot) C (Point) 40 m h = ? 

**Given:**

Distance of the point from the foot of the tower (BC) = 40 m

Angle of elevation of the top of the tower (∠ACB) = 45°

**Formula Used:**

tan(θ) = Perpendicular ÷ Base

**Calculations:**

Let the height of the tower (AB) be h meters.

In right-angled triangle ABC:

⇒ tan(45°) = AB ÷ BC

We know the standard trigonometric value: tan(45°) = 1.

⇒ 1 = h ÷ 40

⇒ h = 40

**∴ The correct answer is 40 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Common Trigonometric Ratios

tan(30°) = 1 ÷ √3 | tan(45°) = 1 | tan(60°) = √3. Remembering these specific values can save significant calculation time in height and distance problems.

Right Isosceles Triangle Property

When an angle of elevation or depression is 45°, the triangle formed is a right isosceles triangle. This means the length of the base directly equals the perpendicular height.

Angle of Elevation vs Depression

The angle of elevation (looking up) is always geometrically equal to the angle of depression (looking down) from the object to the observer due to the alternate interior angles formed by parallel horizontal sightlines.

questions.question: In 540 litres solution of acid and water, the ratio of acid and water is 2 : 10. How many litres of acid must be added to it to get the solution in which the ratio of acid and water is 9 : 5?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total = 540, ratio = 2 : 10 → total parts = 12

Acid = (2/12) × 540 = 90 L, Water = 450 L

Let x L acid added → new ratio = (90 + x) : 450 = 9 : 5

(90 + x)/450 = 9/5 ⇒ 90 + x = 810

**∴ Answer = 720 L**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total solution = 540 L, ratio = 2 : 10

**Formula used:**

Quantity = (Part/Total parts) × Total

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total parts = 2 + 10 = 12

⇒ Acid = (2/12) × 540 = 90 L

⇒ Water = (10/12) × 540 = 450 L

⇒ Let added acid = x

⇒ New ratio = (90 + x) : 450 = 9 : 5

⇒ (90 + x)/450 = 9/5

⇒ 90 + x = 810

⇒ x = 720

**∴ The correct answer is 720 L.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Concept

Ratio shows proportional distribution of components.

Mixture Adjustment

When only one component is added, the other remains constant.

Cross Multiplication

Useful to solve ratio equations quickly.

Alligation Method

Alternative approach for mixture problems.

questions.question: The amount on a sum of ₹5,200 at 10% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective rate of Compound Interest for 2 years at 10% per annum is 10 + 10 + (10 × 10) ÷ 100 = 21%.

Total Amount after 2 years = 100% (Principal) + 21% (Interest) = 121% of Principal.

Amount = 121% of 5200 = (121 × 5200) ÷ 100

Amount = 121 × 52 = 6292

**∴ The correct answer is ₹6,292.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹5,200

Rate of Interest (R) = 10% per annum

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = P × (1 + R/100)T

 ₹5,200 Principal 
• 
 + 10% ₹5,720 1st Year Amount 
• 
 + 10% ₹6,292 Final Amount 
 Interest 1 = ₹520 
 Interest 2 = ₹572 

**Calculations:**

⇒ A = 5200 × (1 + 10 ÷ 100)²

⇒ A = 5200 × (11 ÷ 10)²

⇒ A = 5200 × (121 ÷ 100)

⇒ A = 52 × 121

⇒ A = 6292

**∴ The correct answer is ₹6,292.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate of Compound Interest

For 2 years at a rate of R%, the effective CI rate is calculated as 2R + (R² ÷ 100)%.

Difference Between SI and CI

The difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest for 2 years is given by the direct formula D = P × (R ÷ 100)².

Successive Percentage Method

If the rate of interest is R₁% for the first year and R₂% for the second year, the total Amount A = P × (1 + R₁ ÷ 100) × (1 + R₂ ÷ 100).

questions.question: Rahul’s present age is two-seventh of the present age of his grandmother. After 16 years, his age will be two-fifth of the age of his grandmother at that time. Find the present age of his grandmother.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Present ratio (Rahul : Grandmother) = 2 : 7

Difference = 5 parts (constant)

After 16 years: (2 + 16/k) : (7 + 16/k) = 2 : 5

Solve → k = 12 ⇒ Grandmother = 7k

**∴ Answer = 84 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Rahul’s age = (2/7) of grandmother’s age

After 16 years, ratio becomes 2 : 5

**Formula used:**

Form equation using ratios

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let grandmother’s present age = G

⇒ Rahul’s present age = (2/7)G

⇒ After 16 years: Rahul = (2/7)G + 16, Grandmother = G + 16

⇒ ((2/7)G + 16) / (G + 16) = 2/5

⇒ 5[(2/7)G + 16] = 2(G + 16)

⇒ (10/7)G + 80 = 2G + 32

⇒ Multiply by 7 → 10G + 560 = 14G + 224

⇒ 560 − 224 = 14G − 10G

⇒ 336 = 4G

⇒ G = 84

**∴ The grandmother’s present age is 84 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Ratio Concept

Ratios can be converted into variables like 2x and 7x.

Future Age Rule

Add same years to both persons.

Cross Multiplication

Used to solve proportional equations.

Consistency Check

Always verify final values satisfy given condition.

questions.question: Arun travels from City A to City B. If Arun drives his car at (2)/(3)rd of his normal speed, then he reaches City B 38 minutes late. Find the time (in minutes) that Arun would have taken to travel from City A to City B if he drove at his normal speed.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed becomes 2/3 → Time becomes 3/2 (inverse)

Increase in time = (3/2 − 1) = 1/2 of normal time

Given increase = 38 min

So (1/2) of time = 38 → time = 76 min

**∴ Answer = 76 minutes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Reduced speed = (2/3) of normal speed, delay = 38 minutes

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let normal time = t minutes

⇒ Reduced speed ⇒ new time = (3/2)t

⇒ Increase in time = (3/2)t − t = (1/2)t

⇒ (1/2)t = 38

⇒ t = 76

**∴ The correct answer is 76 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inverse Relation

Speed and time are inversely proportional.

Speed Reduction Effect

If speed becomes a/b, time becomes b/a.

Time Difference Trick

Extra time = (new time − original time).

Shortcut Insight

Use fractional increase in time directly to avoid equations.

questions.question: The average age of 42 students in a class is 14 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 15 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the deviation method for averages:

Teacher's age = Old Average + (New Total Members × Increase in Average)

Teacher's age = 14 + [43 × (15 − 14)]

Teacher's age = 14 + 43 = 57

**∴ The correct answer is 57 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of students = 42

Average age of 42 students = 14 years

New average age (including teacher) = 15 years

New total number of members = 42 + 1 = 43

**Formula Used:**

Sum of observations = Average × Number of observations

 42 Students Avg = 14 → Sum = 588 + Teacher Age = x 
 
 Total 43 Members (Avg = 15) Total Sum = 43 × 15 = 645 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of ages of 42 students = 42 × 14 = 588 years

⇒ Sum of ages of 43 members = 43 × 15 = 645 years

⇒ Teacher's age = Sum of ages of 43 members − Sum of ages of 42 students

⇒ Teacher's age = 645 − 588 = 57 years

**∴ The correct answer is 57 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inclusion of a New Member

When a new member is added to a group, New Value = Old Average + (New Total Members × Change in Average).

Replacement in a Group

If a member is replaced, New Member's Value = Replaced Member's Value + (Total Members × Change in Average).

Exclusion of a Member

When a member leaves, Leaving Member's Value = Old Average − (Remaining Members × Change in Average).

Weighted Average

Combined average of two groups is given by: A = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

questions.question: The ratio of the curved surface area to the total surface area of a solid cylinder is 3 : 5. If its volume is 12,936 cm³, what is its height? ({Use } pi = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of CSA to TSA = h / (h + r) = 3 / 5 ⇒ 3r = 2h ⇒ r = 2h / 3

Volume = π × r² × h = 12936

⇒ (22/7) × (2h/3)² × h = 12936

⇒ (88 / 63) × h³ = 12936

⇒ h³ = 12936 × (63 / 88) = 9261 ⇒ h = 21

**∴ The correct answer is 21 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of Curved Surface Area (CSA) to Total Surface Area (TSA) = 3 : 5

Volume of the cylinder (V) = 12,936 cm³

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

CSA of cylinder = 2πrh

TSA of cylinder = 2πr(h + r)

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

 
 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• h = ? 
• r CSA : TSA = 3 : 5 Vol = 12936 cm³ 

**Calculations:**

⇒ CSA / TSA = 3 / 5

⇒ 2πrh / 2πr(h + r) = 3 / 5

⇒ h / (h + r) = 3 / 5

⇒ 5h = 3(h + r)

⇒ 5h = 3h + 3r

⇒ 2h = 3r

⇒ r = 2h / 3

Now, substituting the value of r in the volume formula:

⇒ V = π × r² × h

⇒ 12936 = (22/7) × (2h / 3)² × h

⇒ 12936 = (22/7) × (4h² / 9) × h

⇒ 12936 = (88 / 63) × h³

⇒ h³ = (12936 × 63) / 88

⇒ h³ = 147 × 63

⇒ h³ = 9261

⇒ h = 21

**∴ The correct answer is 21 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of a Cylinder

Volume = πr²h | Curved Surface Area = 2πrh | Total Surface Area = 2πr(h + r)

Properties of a Cone

Volume = (1/3)πr²h | Curved Surface Area = πrl | Total Surface Area = πr(l + r), where slant height l = √(r² + h²)

Properties of a Sphere

Volume = (4/3)πr³ | Total Surface Area = 4πr²

questions.question: A cricketer has an average of 68 runs over 9 innings. If he scores 130 runs in the 10th inning, by how many runs (rounded off to the nearest whole number) does his average score increase?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Old average = 68 → total runs = 68 × 9 = 612

New total = 612 + 130 = 742

New average = 742 ÷ 10 = 74.2

Increase = 74.2 − 68 = 6.2 ≈ 6

**∴ Answer = 6 runs**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average after 9 innings = 68, Score in 10th inning = 130

**Formula used:**

Average = Total runs ÷ Number of innings

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total runs in 9 innings = 68 × 9 = 612

⇒ Total runs in 10 innings = 612 + 130 = 742

⇒ New average = 742 ÷ 10 = 74.2

⇒ Increase in average = 74.2 − 68 = 6.2

⇒ Rounded off = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Formula

Average = Total ÷ Number of observations

Updating Average

New total = Old total + new value

Effect of High Score

If new score > average, average increases.

Rounding Rule

Round to nearest whole number.

questions.question: Simplify (x - 3)² + (x + 3)² .
questions.solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Using the standard algebraic identity: (a − b)² + (a + b)² = 2(a² + b²) Here, substituting a = x and b = 3 directly into the formula: ⇒ (x − 3)² + (x + 3)² = 2(x² + 3²) ⇒ 2(x² + 9) = 2x² + 18 **∴ The correct answer is 2x² + 18.**

questions.question: The greatest number that will divide 45, 95 and 185, so as to leave the same remainder in each case is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Required Number = HCF of (|x − y|, |y − z|, |z − x|)

⇒ HCF of (|45 − 95|, |95 − 185|, |185 − 45|)

⇒ HCF of (50, 90, 140) = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers given are 45, 95 and 185.

**Formula Used:**

When a number divides x, y, and z leaving the same remainder in each case, the greatest such number is the HCF of their absolute differences.

 Finding differences on a number line 
• 
• 
• 
• 45 95 185 
 Diff = 50 
 Diff = 90 
 Diff = 140 

**Calculations:**

⇒ First difference = |95 − 45| = 50

⇒ Second difference = |185 − 95| = 90

⇒ Third difference = |185 − 45| = 140

⇒ Now, find the HCF of 50, 90 and 140.

⇒ Factors of 50 = 2 × 5 × 5

⇒ Factors of 90 = 2 × 3 × 3 × 5

⇒ Factors of 140 = 2 × 2 × 5 × 7

⇒ The common prime factors are 2 and 5.

⇒ HCF = 2 × 5 = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Greatest Number leaving same remainder

When asked to find the greatest number dividing x, y, and z leaving the same remainder, calculate the HCF of |x − y|, |y − z|, and |z − x|.

Greatest Number leaving different remainders

The greatest number that divides x, y, and z leaving remainders a, b, and c respectively is the HCF of (x − a), (y − b), and (z − c).

Least Number leaving same remainder

The least number which when divided by x, y, and z leaves the same remainder 'r' in each case is given by LCM(x, y, z) + r.

questions.question: The prices of articles of types P, Q and R are ₹280, ₹180 and ₹100, respectively. Rajiv purchases these articles in the ratio 3 : 4 : 3, spending a total of ₹27,900. How many articles of type Q did he buy?

Let quantities = 3x, 4x, 3x

Total cost = 3x×280 + 4x×180 + 3x×100

= (840 + 720 + 300)x = 1860x

1860x = 27900 → x = 15

**∴ Articles of type Q = 4x = 60**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Prices: P = 280, Q = 180, R = 100; Ratio = 3 : 4 : 3; Total cost = 27900

**Formula used:**

Total cost = (Quantity × Price) summed for all items

**Calculation:**

⇒ Cost of P = 3x × 280 = 840x

⇒ Cost of Q = 4x × 180 = 720x

⇒ Cost of R = 3x × 100 = 300x

⇒ Total cost = 840x + 720x + 300x = 1860x

⇒ 1860x = 27900

⇒ x = 27900 ÷ 1860 = 15

⇒ Quantity of Q = 4x = 60

**∴ The correct answer is 60.**

questions.question: If 20% of a number is added to 96, then the result is the same number. 65% of the same number is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Every number represents 100% of itself.

Given, 20% of the number + 96 = 100% of the number.

⇒ 100% − 20% = 80% of the number = 96

⇒ 1% of the number = 96 ÷ 80 = 1.2

⇒ 65% of the number = 65 × 1.2 = 78

**∴ The correct answer is 78.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

20% of a number + 96 = The same number

 20% 80% 96 
• 
• 
• 100% (Original Number) 

**Calculations:**

Let the original number be N.

⇒ 20% of N + 96 = N

⇒ (20 ÷ 100) × N + 96 = N

⇒ 0.2N + 96 = N

⇒ N − 0.2N = 96

⇒ 0.8N = 96

⇒ N = 96 ÷ 0.8

⇒ N = 120

Now, we are required to find 65% of the same number:

⇒ 65% of 120 = (65 ÷ 100) × 120

⇒ 0.65 × 120 = 78

**∴ The correct answer is 78.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Base of Percentage

The original or initial value in any percentage problem is always taken as 100%. All additions or subtractions are calculated relative to this fixed base value.

Multiplying Factor

To directly find a percentage of a number, simply multiply the number by the percentage fraction (e.g., 65% = 0.65). If a value increases by R%, it becomes (1 + R÷100) × Original Value.

Successive Percentage Change

When a number undergoes two successive percentage changes of A% and B%, the net percentage change can be calculated using the formula: Net Change = A + B + (A × B)÷100 %.

questions.question: The price of fuel decreases by 50%, 35% and 50% in three successive months, but increases by 45% in the fourth month. What is the percentage increase/decrease in the price of fuel in the fourth month as compared to its original price? (Round off the answer to two decimal places)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive multipliers: 0.5 × 0.65 × 0.5 × 1.45

= 0.25 × 0.65 × 1.45

= 0.1625 × 1.45 = 0.235625

Net = 23.5625% of original

**∴ Decrease = 100 − 23.5625 = 76.44% (approx)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Successive changes: −50%, −35%, −50%, +45%

**Formula used:**

New value = Original × (1 ± % change)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let original price = 100

⇒ After 1st month: 100 × 0.5 = 50

⇒ After 2nd month: 50 × 0.65 = 32.5

⇒ After 3rd month: 32.5 × 0.5 = 16.25

⇒ After 4th month: 16.25 × 1.45 = 23.5625

⇒ Net decrease = 100 − 23.5625 = 76.4375%

⇒ Rounded = 76.44%

**∴ The price decreases by 76.44%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage

Apply changes one after another using multiplication.

Multiplier Method

Decrease → multiply by (1 − r/100), Increase → (1 + r/100).

Compounding Effect

Changes are not additive, they are multiplicative.

Final Comparison

Compare final value with original to find net % change.

⇒ Average speed = 2d ÷ (d/40)

questions.question: The sum of the digits of a two-digit number is 5. If 9 is added to this number, the digits interchange their places. Find the number.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let number = 10a + b, with a + b = 5

After adding 9 → digits reverse → 10b + a

So: 10a + b + 9 = 10b + a ⇒ 9a − 9b = −9

a − b = −1 and a + b = 5

**∴ Answer = 23**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of digits = 5, digits reverse after adding 9

**Formula used:**

Number = 10a + b

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let tens digit = a and units digit = b

⇒ a + b = 5

⇒ Number = 10a + b

⇒ After adding 9: 10a + b + 9 = 10b + a

⇒ 9a − 9b = −9

⇒ a − b = −1

⇒ Solve with a + b = 5

⇒ Adding: 2a = 4 ⇒ a = 2

⇒ b = 3

⇒ Number = 10a + b = 23

**∴ The correct answer is 23.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Two-Digit Number Form

Any two-digit number = 10a + b

Digit Reversal

Reversed number = 10b + a

Equation Formation

Translate conditions into equations to solve.

System of Equations

Solve simultaneous equations to find digits.

questions.question: The marked price of a television set is ₹35,000. A shopkeeper allows a discount of 22% and gets a profit of 75%. What is the cost price of the television set?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Discount 22% → SP = 78% of MP = 35000 × 0.78 = 27300

Profit 75% → SP = 175% of CP

So CP = SP ÷ 1.75

= 27300 ÷ 1.75 = 15600

**∴ Answer = ₹15600**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price = 35000, Discount = 22%, Profit = 75%

**Formula used:**

SP = MP × (1 − Discount), SP = CP × (1 + Profit)

**Calculation:**

⇒ SP = 35000 × (78/100) = 27300

⇒ SP = 1.75 × CP

⇒ CP = 27300 ÷ 1.75

⇒ CP = 15600

**∴ The correct answer is ₹15600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Discount Concept

SP = MP × (1 − Discount/100)

Profit Formula

SP = CP × (1 + Profit/100)

Reverse Calculation

CP = SP ÷ (1 + Profit/100)

Successive Steps

Apply discount first, then profit relation.

questions.question:
A shopkeeper declares the given three schemes of discounts. Which of the following schemes is most beneficial to a customer?

A. Buy 5 items and get 23 of the same items free

B. Two successive discounts of 14% and 37%

C. Two successive equal discounts of 39%
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Discount % for Scheme A = [Free Items ÷ (Paid + Free Items)] × 100 = (23 ÷ 28) × 100 ≈ 82.14%

Discount % for Scheme B = 14 + 37 − (14 × 37 ÷ 100) = 51 − 5.18 = 45.82%

Discount % for Scheme C = 39 + 39 − (39 × 39 ÷ 100) = 78 − 15.21 = 62.79%

Scheme A gives the highest discount, making it the most beneficial scheme for the customer.

**∴ The correct answer is Only A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Scheme A: Buy 5 items and get 23 free.

Scheme B: Successive discounts of 14% and 37%.

Scheme C: Two successive equal discounts of 39%.

**Formula Used:**

Discount % in Buy X Get Y Free = (Y ÷ (X + Y)) × 100

Successive discount of a% and b% = a + b − (a × b ÷ 100)

 Scheme A 82.14% Scheme B 45.82% Scheme C 62.79% 
• Effective Discount Comparison 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total items in Scheme A = 5 + 23 = 28

⇒ Effective discount for Scheme A = (23 ÷ 28) × 100

⇒ Effective discount for Scheme A = 82.14%

⇒ Effective discount for Scheme B = 14 + 37 − (14 × 37 ÷ 100)

⇒ Effective discount for Scheme B = 51 − 5.18 = 45.82%

⇒ Effective discount for Scheme C = 39 + 39 − (39 × 39 ÷ 100)

⇒ Effective discount for Scheme C = 78 − 15.21 = 62.79%

⇒ Comparing the overall effective discounts: 82.14% > 62.79% > 45.82%

⇒ The maximum discount is provided in Scheme A.

**∴ The correct answer is Only A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discounts

When two successive discounts of a% and b% are offered, the overall effective discount is determined using the direct formula: a + b − (a × b ÷ 100).

Buy X Get Y Free

In promotional schemes involving free products, the customer pays only for X items but takes home a total of (X + Y) items. The actual percentage discount equals (Y ÷ (X + Y)) × 100.

Customer vs Shopkeeper Perspective

A higher percentage discount minimizes the selling price, which makes it highly beneficial for a customer. On the other hand, a lower discount percentage yields more profit margin for the shopkeeper.

questions.question: A small sphere has a radius of 5 cm. A larger sphere is created by uniformly expanding the smaller sphere. The radius of the larger sphere is 15 cm. How many times greater is the surface area of the larger sphere compared to the smaller sphere?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Surface area ∝ r²

Radius ratio = 15 : 5 = 3 : 1

Area ratio = 3² : 1² = 9 : 1

Larger is 9 times smaller

**∴ Answer = 9 times**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Small sphere radius = 5 cm, Large sphere radius = 15 cm

**Formula used:**

Surface area of sphere = 4πr²

**Calculation:**

⇒ Surface area (small) = 4π × 5² = 100π

⇒ Surface area (large) = 4π × 15² = 900π

⇒ Ratio = 900π : 100π = 9 : 1

**∴ The larger sphere has 9 times the surface area.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of Sphere

Surface area = 4πr²

Scaling Rule

Area changes with square of radius.

Radius Ratio

If radius becomes k times, area becomes k² times.

Volume Note

Volume changes with cube of radius (r³).
